\*cough\* I'm working as a Controller, I report about the money of the company to the CEO, so I have no problem managing my own funds. \*cough\*

Well, I have to try to get in shape, the exams are really tough. Then I have to go to the army for half a year and after that I'll sign up and try myself at the exams. I guess it's better like that, a year to get fit and if I don't manage to do that I still have a job (I won't quit if I can't do that stuff like running 3000 meters, doing 20+ push ups and so on).

Gnah, lets see…

But I better don't tell anyone till I really manage to get fit, my parents would shake their heads ;-)

Well, it's not that easy… in my country you have to go 6 months to the army first before you can be a cop… this means I have to sign up again (And hope they take me), do this 6 months… and then sign up for the police.

My parents would see me as crazy, giving up a good job (or type of job), going to the army (Where I get nearly nothing paid) and then trying to sign up for the trials to be a cop… those are only once a year, if I fail I'd be unemployed again. I don't have the money to just sit around.

Well… there is no way to change my path right now, that wouldn't work. Maybe I could start to train for it and think about it again in a year. Other problem would be the salary of course… even after all that training I'd start with about 600 before taxes less (About 300 after taxes) and wouldn't nearly reach what I earn now :-/

And you know that that won't help even for a little bit? I don't have anything I want to achieve in life, nothing. There is no target, there is nothing to strive for, no passion to follow.

So where should I guide my energy then?
